title: Log Sticks And Chests
description: Skip Making Planks! Craft Sticks And Chests Out Of Logs Directly :D
body:
Allows You To Craft Both Sticks And Chests Directly Out Of Logs!

Works With Logs, Stripped Logs, Wood And Stripped Wood.

_________________________________

8 Logs ---> 4 Chests

2 Logs ---> 16 Sticks
